task.title: Ruling: may / stop being remote-blocked (SsrMode::Async vs auth 302)
task.description: Decision-first, from WB-01M0DT46WN (2026-08-20): every top-level route is SsrMode::Async so the auth redirects can emit a real 302, which means the FIRST byte of desktop/mobile SSR waits on the full remote auth chain (splash now covers it visually; the wait itself remains). The alternative — serve shell HTML immediately and resolve the session client-side with a loading state — trades away the server-side 302 the auth flow depends on and is an architectural change. Needs a maintainer ruling on whether the trade is wanted; if yes, file the implementation as its own story. Evidence and measured timeline in specs/architecture-spike.md.
